purpose: Check whether vertically swapping EO camera pixel rows is a CPU hotspot and whether removing the swap preserves image-quality measurements.

environment.profiler: Visual Studio CPU Usage sampling, summarized with xperf symbols

source_snapshots.embedded_label_note: The existing CMake build had an older configure-time revision label. The source snapshots above come from Git at capture time. CMake was reconfigured after these captures so later builds embed the current revision.

interpretation: The before trace concentrated sample weight in the byte-swap routine used to reverse image rows. That routine was absent from the after trace. These are one sampling capture per version; sample weights are not exact elapsed function times, so the totals do not establish a percentage speedup. The confirmed change is that the CPU row copy was removed while the measured image-quality values stayed identical.

verification.image_quality_after_vertical_flip: brightness, contrast, and sharpness matched exactly
